findings.detail: Build Packet registration fails closed on contradictory product state, unknown/inactive requirements, wrong repository, unsafe scope, missing evidence, and base/candidate identity mismatch.
Builder cannot emit audit PASS, Auditor context must differ from Builder context, audit binds to exact candidate, mutation invalidates audit, and only Governor may grant merge eligibility.
The loop records observations without promoting them and deliberately performs no model, Git, merge, or external effect.

PR review repairs authenticate role contexts through Governor-owned trusted sets, require candidate-bound PASS evidence, bind packet/audit to specification identity with final revalidation, allow only active work, and canonicalize paths before scope checks.
Refreshed dependency bases preserve repository- and mission-bound history and governed read-only Product Brain state; the integrated stack passes all gates.

Role credentials bind action, scope, payload, and loop identity; independent roles cannot share context identity or effective signing keys; packet, inspection, handoff, and audit sequence fields are immutable.
Protected-path policy handles separator-aware wildcard intersection, root-level governance packages, and case/hyphen variants of North Star paths while owner authorization remains packet-bound.
GitHub Codex independently reviewed exact head 0f8f6ca on 2026-09-18 and returned no inline findings.
